usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog and EZOfficeInventory holds tracked assets, so “New Product” can add one through “Create Asset”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Asset” in EZOfficeInventory
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets an asset record, so tracking starts when the product exists.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” in Shopify fires on every edit, so “Create Inventory” could repeat for one order.
